_about: W4 agent tasks over the w4-fixture.py project. {name} is the project's name; checks read results/w4-truth.json. Checks: tool (one of these Kobo tools succeeded), no_tool (none of these was called; * is a wildcard), says (every entry is a case-insensitive regex that must match), number (a number within tol of a truth value), numbers (every value of a truth dict), after (Kobo's state once the task is done). A task passes when every check does. Dashboard tasks (dash-*) run in order on one dashboard: dash-create makes it, the others change or read it; dash-map needs Kenya's boundaries in the maps folder (dash.sh boundaries KEN --levels ADM1,ADM2). after: dashboard checks the project's newest dashboard in kobo-dash's database: exists, access, refresh_seconds, format, boundaries (a layer), widget (one widget has these keys and values), filter (one filter does).

tasks.prompt: Which KoboToolbox projects do I have? Just list their names.
What questions does the {name} ask? Which of them are multiple choice?
How many submissions does the {name} have?
Break down the {name} submissions by district, with a count for each district.
In the {name}, which enumerator did the most interviews, and how many?
How many interviews has each enumerator done for the {name}?
What is the most common main source of drinking water in the {name}?
Give me a table of households per main water source for the {name}.
What share of households in the {name} treat their water? Give a percentage.
What is the average household size in the {name}?
In the {name}, how many households in Likoni get their water from a river?
Which need do households in the {name} mention most often?
On which interview date were the most {name} interviews done?
Are there households entered twice in the {name}? Use the phone number to tell. How many are duplicated?
Which questions in the {name} have missing answers, and how many are missing?
In the {name}, are there households that report more children than people living there? How many?
Do a data quality review of the {name}: missing answers, duplicates and odd values. Don't change anything.
How many {name} comments mention the borehole?
In the {name}, what water source did the household with phone number {duplicate_phones.0} report?
Export the {name} data as a CSV file.
Write a short weekly digest of the {name}: volume, who collected, what the answers say, and anything to follow up. Read-only.
Compare water sources between Kisauni and Mvita in the {name}.
Show me the {name} form as an XLSForm.
For the {name}, add an integer question 'How many minutes to the water source?' after the water source question. Don't deploy it: show me a preview first.
In the {name}, households were entered twice (same phone number). Put the second copy of each on hold with the validation status, and leave the first copies alone.
Approve all of Amina's submissions in the {name}.
Delete all of Daudi's submissions from the {name}.

Connect to kf.kobotoolbox.org and list my projects there.
Which Kobo account and server are you connected to?
Make a live dashboard of the {name} that I can share with the team later.

Add a chart to the {name} dashboard comparing the main source of drinking water across districts.
Let people viewing the {name} dashboard pick a district, so every chart shows just that district.
Add a map of the districts in the {name} dashboard (they are sub-counties of Mombasa, Kenya), shaded by how many households were interviewed in each.
What does the {name} dashboard show right now? Give me the main numbers.
Publish the {name} dashboard so anyone on the office Wi-Fi can open it, and give me the link.
The {name} dashboard only needs to check for new data once an hour. Set that.
Make a second, story-style version of the {name} dashboard: one scrolling page that walks a reader through where households get their water.
Actually the {name} dashboard has household details on it. Make it so only people with a password can open it.
Delete the {name} dashboard.
